gemini.title: Blue Green Infra Sport Facilities Ogl
gemini.abstract: Blue Green Infra Sport Facilities Ogl is an authoritative dataset published by Natural England. It represents blue green infra sport facilities ogl features using multipoint geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Natural England as open environmental and conservation data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
